verdict.rationale: The CLI subcommand explicitly documents spawning/manipulating panes on a running instance, and a hands-on runtime probe confirms a fully headless control loop (mux-server --daemonize, cli spawn, send-text, get-text, list) with no GUI session required — directly matching the CI/automation story. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI documentation/examples and independent community reports of using WezTerm in CI pipelines.
